scope: Targeted critical review; selected primary studies, opposite findings and withdrawal records. Search corpus is not an exhaustive systematic review.

evidence.model: Mouse CLP; immune recruitment and systemic outcomes
evidence.exposure: 1 or 10 mg/kg oral; 30 min before and 6/24 h after CLP
evidence.finding: 1 mg/kg improved survival (80% versus 50% CLP control); 10 mg/kg increased mortality to 85%
evidence.limitation: Preventive plus post-treatment regimen; not cardiac-specific endpoint; dose-dependent harm retained
evidence.independence: Independent wet-lab sepsis study, not independent cardiac transcriptomic replication

evidence.model: Fyn knockout and LPS endotoxemia mice
evidence.exposure: Dasatinib 10 mg/kg oral (indexed abstract); Fyn KO versus WT
evidence.finding: Fyn depletion or inhibition attenuated inflammatory readouts; supports context-specific SFK hypothesis
evidence.limitation: Not proof of cardiomyocyte protection; mRNA direction cannot proxy Fyn activity
evidence.read_depth: full text available; abstract and selected sections reviewed

evidence.model: LPS-stimulated Jurkat cells and CLP mice
evidence.exposure: Not verified from accessible full text
evidence.finding: Reported MAPK14/NF-kB-related reduction of T-cell senescence and organ injury
evidence.limitation: Abstract-level; not myocardial rescue; precise exposure unverified
evidence.independence: Different experimental report; not cardiac replication

evidence.model: LPS rat myocardium; gene qPCR; CMAP prediction
evidence.exposure: Rat disease induction LPS 10 mg/kg for 24 h; no dasatinib intervention demonstrated
evidence.finding: Already proposed dasatinib and KU-0063794; IL1B/RAC2/VEGFA/ITGB1 marker study
evidence.limitation: Drug prediction is not efficacy validation; GSE185754 reused in their validation and our earlier work; reduces novelty of simple rediscovery
evidence.independence: Independent rat discovery experiment but overlapping public support dataset and related perturbation-screen concept

evidence.model: Pneumococcal infection; human/mouse cardiomyocytes; ampicillin-rescued mice
evidence.exposure: Intraperitoneal ponatinib adjunct to ampicillin; exact dose/time not verified from accessible full text
evidence.finding: Reported reduced troponin, collagen deposition and preserved cardiac function after infection
evidence.limitation: Pneumolysin/necroptosis model differs from LPS; antibiotic co-treatment; full text body not retrieved
evidence.read_depth: PubMed abstract; NCBI XML metadata only
evidence.independence: Independent infection-related cardiac experiment, not broad sepsis efficacy proof

evidence.model: Human iPSC-CMs and HFD ApoE-null mice
evidence.exposure: Main cell experiments 1 uM for 24 h; mice 15 mg/kg/day for 14 days
evidence.finding: ATP synthase impairment, GCN2-eIF2alpha-ATF4 ISR activation and cardiac injury; ISR inhibition improved outcomes
evidence.limitation: Cell exposure 10 times our 0.1 uM; different duration/background; demonstrates plausible counter-mechanism, not proof of toxicity at our dose
evidence.independence: Independent cardiac experiments, different publication and models

evidence.model: Recombinant RIPK2, reporter cells, macrophages and human monocytes
evidence.exposure: Low nanomolar range; ponatinib RIPK2 IC50 6.7 nM, regorafenib 41 nM
evidence.finding: Inhibited NOD1/2-RIPK2 responses; selective doses did not inhibit LPS-induced TNF responses
evidence.limitation: NOD and TLR4/LPS are not interchangeable; kinase inhibition is not established by target mRNA
evidence.independence: Independent biochemical and immune-cell experiments; not cardiac rescue

evidence.model: CLP mice, four groups of six
evidence.finding: Reduced lung injury/inflammatory markers; increased VE-cadherin; TIE2 mRNA did not differ significantly from CLP
evidence.limitation: Prophylactic lung study, not myocardial rescue; no direct dose bridge to 1 uM cardiac culture

evidence.finding: Concentration/time-related ATP depletion, mitochondrial abnormalities and loss of viability
evidence.limitation: Cell-line/toxicology model; dose-specific effects at our 1 uM cannot be inferred from abstract

evidence.exposure: 200 mg/kg/day for 42 days in mice; 8/16/32 uM in cells
evidence.finding: EPHA2 reduction, AKT signaling inhibition and injury; EPHA2 restoration or schisandrin C protected
evidence.limitation: Higher/longer exposure than present screen; cannot assume any RNA reversal is protective

evidence.model: Bioinformatics using GSE146096 with claimed cell validation
evidence.finding: Retracted article; retraction notice PMID38189000 DOI10.1155/2023/9862498
evidence.limitation: Excluded from positive and negative mechanistic evidence; original GEO resource evaluated separately from this reuse publication
evidence.read_depth: PubMed original abstract and retraction record

evidence.exposure: Multiple concentrations and 1/3/5 days; GEO overall_design has inconsistent drug-count wording
evidence.finding: ERS-dependent cardiac damage mechanisms; dataset enables exposure-specific comparison after design audit
evidence.limitation: Triplicate cultures are not automatically independent donors; multiplexed sample structure requires decoding
evidence.independence: New study accession; exact donors and design need audit before analysis

evidence.exposure: RNA-seq single Ncyte CM1 line, three replicates; ponatinib 1 uM, dasatinib 0.3 uM
evidence.finding: Independent morphology/electrophysiology/transcriptomics safety study; RNA-seq differs from multi-line imaging design
evidence.limitation: Do not equate three RNA-seq replicates to three donors; no regorafenib among inspected treatment labels
evidence.read_depth: full text and sample-level GEO metadata
evidence.independence: Independent resource; one RNA-seq line limits population replication

datasets.verified_unit: 14 heart samples: sepsis7/control7; unique title-defined individuals
datasets.material: Autopsy frozen heart; controls were critically ill non-infectious deaths
datasets.availability: SRA raw reads linked; GEO lists per-sepsis-individual differential tables, not a ready complete sample-count matrix
datasets.limitation: Different platform and control context from GSE79962; must obtain/reconstruct sample counts and audit clinical metadata before inferential replication
datasets.next_action: First choice for independent disease replication; resolve expression matrix first

datasets.verified_unit: 10 heart records from7 patients: FFPE5cases+2controls; extra FF records repeat3cases
datasets.material: Meningococcal septic shock autopsy; FFPE and fresh-frozen
datasets.availability: Sample expression tables downloaded; processed XLSX and raw CEL archive listed
datasets.limitation: Use FFPE5+2 for comparable primary subset; no independent FF controls; small n and one pathogen
datasets.next_action: Second disease cohort; unique-patient and storage-stratified design fixed before scoring

datasets.verified_unit: High-risk serum3 versus low-risk serum4 RNA samples; source independence requires further donor/pooling audit
datasets.material: iPSC-CMs exposed to10% pediatric septic serum24h
datasets.availability: Raw-count and TPM matrices publicly listed; sample metadata downloaded
datasets.limitation: Both groups have septic serum; no nonseptic control in this submission; cannot label as patient myocardium replication
datasets.next_action: Optional translational context after serum/donor mapping audit

datasets.verified_unit: 54 total samples;3DAS+3PON, each listed biological replicate; RNA-seq from one Ncyte CM1 line
datasets.availability: Raw-count XLSX listed; full sample metadata and paper retrieved
datasets.limitation: DAS0.3uM/PON1uM; differs from current0.1uM; not3independent RNA-seq donors; no REG detected
datasets.next_action: Prioritize as exposure/stress context comparison, not multi-donor efficacy validation

datasets.verified_unit: 502 metadata records; primary cardiomyocyte-like lines; design needs unpacking
datasets.material: Human heart-derived cells; kinase inhibitor toxicity study
datasets.limitation: GEO overall_design mentions4 drugs but series describes26; resolve actual design; retracted reuse paper does not itself invalidate original source
Well triplicates are not3donors; actual target-drug coverage and line identities require audit

datasets.verified_unit: 1GEO record encodes multiplexed experiment; not1biological replicate
datasets.limitation: Decode barcodes/doses/replicates; unclear independent donors and inconsistent drug-count wording

datasets.verified_unit: 9mouse ventricular samples according to series search
datasets.material: High-fat ApoE-null mice treated with ponatinib/placebo
datasets.limitation: Comorbidity/toxicity model; not infection disease or protection study

datasets.verified_unit: Same super-series GSE217424 as current GSE217421
datasets.material: Related iPSC-CM lines and drug study
datasets.limitation: Same study/donor origin; cannot declare independent by accession difference
